itens.trecho: Desinteressante. Esta é uma sequela de "Jurassic Park" e narra a visita de uma equipa de cientistas e paleontólogos a uma ilha vizinha ao parque, onde ficavam parte das instalações científicas, abandonadas e deixadas para os dinossauros. No entanto, encontrarão outra equipa de exploradores, com intenções menos científicas.

Actually where you're going is the only place in the world where the geese chase you! The Lost World: Jurassic Park is directed by Steven Spielberg and adapted to screenplay by David Koepp from the novel written by Michael Crichton.

The other 2 star / 40% review of this movie is on point. The Lost World: Jurassic Park sucks on so many levels. I had Jurassic Park 1 on repeat for nearly 24 hours and every time I sat down I had a laugh or a feeling of awe or excitement. Jurassic Park 1 is truly a marvel. Apart from the squealing, the characters are well written and well acted.
